rules: When mstatus.VS is set to Off, attempting to execute any vector instruction or access the vector CSRs raises an illegal-instruction exception.
When mstatus.VS is set to Initial or Clean and a vector state change occurs, mstatus.VS changes to Dirty.
When mstatus.VS is set to Initial or Clean, mstatus.VS may change to Dirty even when there is no change in vector state.
When mstatus.VS is Dirty, mstatus.SD is 1.
When mstatus.VS is not Dirty, mstatus.SD is set in accordance with existing specifications.
